scope: Selected retained database branches; not a production reliability estimate

definitions.success_rate: Latest observed engineering outcome; unknown outcomes excluded with coverage counts. Not release success.
definitions.mttr: First engineering failure in an incident through next passing required engineering validation; includes review/idle time. Unresolved incidents excluded and listed.
definitions.latency: WORKFLOW_STARTED through terminal audit/checkpoint completion only. Imported/open workflows unavailable.
definitions.execution_time: Union of explicitly paired agent start/end wall intervals, not CPU time; parallel intervals not double-counted.
definitions.human_wait: Review-ready audit/checkpoint to decision wall time, including scheduling/resume overhead; partial coverage only.
definitions.rollback: Unique transaction IDs; duplicate wrapper events are not additional rollbacks.
definitions.provenance: Caller-supplied cohort labels; copied/forked databases are branch observations, not independent production samples.
